{{Mainspace/Character}} {{Character Infobox |color={{dragon color}} |corecolor={{dragon color light}} |bordercolor={{dragon color dark}} |name=Hassel |jname=ハッサク |tmname=Hassaku |text=fff |image=Hassel HZ.png |caption=Art from ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |size=150px |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Paldea]] |gender=Male |hair=Blond |eyes=Yellow }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{dragon color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon anime|Pokémon Horizons: the Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'' |enva=N/A |jpva=Ryōtarō Okiayu }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{dragon color light}} |member=[[Paldea League]] |rank=Elite Four |specialty={{t|Dragon}}-types }} |} '''Hassel''' (Japanese: '''ハッサク''' ''Hassaku'') is a member of the [[Elite Four]] of the [[Paldea]] [[region]] and the art teacher at [[Naranja Academy]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Dragon}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In animation== ===History=== Hassel made his first appearance alongside [[Rika]] in ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'' when welcoming [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] to [[Naranja Academy]]. Later, Hassel appeared with the other members of the [[Elite Four]] watching Liko's battle against [[Ann]]. In ''[[HZ048|Sparkle! The Glow of Flame and Art!]]'', Hassel and [[Nemona]] helped with some details of the annual [[Artazon Art Festival]], during the event, he discovered that Liko is [[Alex]]'s daughter. After taking Liko, Roy and Dot to meet with [[Brassius]], Hassel evaluated the works of art constructed by his students and then watched Roy's {{Tera}}stal battle against Brassius. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'', Hassel took part in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against Roy and Brassius during the [[Elite Four Tag Battle]], eventually winning the battle with his Baxcalibur and Flapple. Hassel then cried tears of joy upon seeing Roy's motivation to get stronger. In ''[[HZ067|Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!]]'', Hassel and Brassius watched Roy's battle against Liko, Hassel praised Roy for his improved battling skills and was crying tears of joy when he won the match. Hassel appeared again in ''[[HZ079|Over the Top!]]'' when the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] arrived at the {{pal|Pokémon League}} asking for permission to go to [[Area Zero]]. Later, he [[Battle judge|referee'd]] Liko, Roy, and Dot's battle against [[Geeta]]. === Character === In the past, Hassel mentored Brassius during his times of insecurity with art. Hassel has a gentle personality, but also has a tendency to get overly emotional and cry with tears of joy upon admiring another person's character and progress. He is also very proud and caring of his students as a teacher and encourages them whenever they make any form of progress. ===Pokémon=== This is the list of Hassel's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the anime: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hassel |pkmn=Gible |gender=male |type1=Dragon |type2=Ground |img=Hassel Gible.png |epnum=HZ048 |epname=Sparkle! None of Gible's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hassel |pkmn=Baxcalibur |type1=Dragon |type2=Ice |img=Hassel Baxcalibur.png |epnum=HZ055 |epname=Showdown!
